The '''meditation pavilion''' was located at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]] in the pavilion for a week to summon every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order|Order]] for a [[Conclave on Ossus|convocation]] on the future of the Order.<ref name="DN III" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''
